bio.text: According to his campaign website, Robbie Mahrou is an independent candidate for New Hampshire's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
NHPR lists his residence as Walpole, New Hampshire, based on Secretary of State records.

Citizens Count, a nonpartisan New Hampshire voter guide, publishes a candidate profile in which his experience is described as loan officer, Hollywood producer and founder of a trading community called RoadHouse.
That profile also lists a Bachelor of Business Administration from Baylor University.

sources.title: Los candidatos para el Congreso en New Hampshire este año: Te contamos quiénes son
